method: Whole Japanese/English duplicate retrieval plus English full-text ranking, followed by separately recorded model semantic review; no embedding model, translation generation or automatic publication.
limitation: Ranked candidates and duplicate wording are retrieval evidence, not semantic equivalence. Absence from retrieval never proves absence from the project. Easy Chat omission is a project-level documented limitation; reusable words elsewhere are checked separately.

semanticReview.method: non_blind_model_comparison_of_original_quotes; no Chinese authored, rewritten, concatenated or published

upstreamStatement.scope: The project explicitly says Easy Chat phrases, including related TV/Tower combinations, were not localized. This does not mean every reusable word is absent elsewhere.
